refsynopsisdiv.title: Syntax
refsynopsisdiv.synopsis: img_out = resize(img_in, size[, scale_x[, scale_y[, interpolation]]])

listitem.para: Scale factor along the X axis (double matrix) (default 0).
Scale factor along the Y axis (double matrix) (default 0).

itemizedlist.member: INTER_AREA: resampling using pixel area relation.
INTER_CUBIC: a bicubic interpolation over 4x4 pixel neighborhood.
INTER_LANCZOS4: a Lanczos interpolation over 8x8 pixel neighborhood.

refsection.title: Description
refsection.para: resize resizes an image, either to the specified size size, or by using the scale factors scale_x and scale_y.
